## About Hologic

Hologic helps women around the world live healthier lives.

We develop innovative medical technologies that effectively detect, diagnose and treat health
conditions and raise the standard of care globally.

We know women face unique health challenges at every stage of life, and we are passionate about
being a force for good.

all we do. We believe everyone should feel welcomed, valued and heard, because great ideas come from

grow their careers while making the world a better, healthier place.
